nodes.name: Order Webhook
nodes.notes:
POST /webhook/bf-factory {"businessUrl": "...", "sourceUrls": ["..."], "additionalInstruction": "...", "order": "...", "maxIter": 3}
Also accepts ?businessUrl=, ?order=, etc. on the query string.

nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs the demo order baked into Job Intake.

assignments.name: order
assignments.value: ={{ ($json.body && $json.body.order) ? $json.body.order : (($json.query && $json.query.order) ? $json.query.order : 'Construieste un website premium pentru o brutarie artizanala din Sibiu') }}

nodes.name: Job Intake
nodes.notes: The job identity. Every stage reads runId/businessUrl/sourceUrls/additionalInstruction/order from here.

nodes.name: Start at QA?
nodes.notes:
startAt=quality -> straight to Browser Capture (re-test only).
otherwise -> the full factory.

nodes.name: Create Job
nodes.notes: Opens output/<runId>/job.json and initializes job lifecycle state.

nodes.name: Normalize Brief
nodes.notes: Business URL & Order -> brief: trade classification, city, language, and search queries.

nodes.name: Capability Router
nodes.notes: Evaluates provider eligibility, rate limits & telemetry across research, content, design, code, image, video, 3D, and evidence channels.

nodes.name: Research Pool Dispatcher
nodes.notes: Fans out brief to parallel AI research workers and fallback floor.

nodes.name: Gemini Research Worker
nodes.notes: Gemini 2.5 Flash research worker: extracts localized market context and trade keywords.

nodes.name: DeepSeek Research Worker
nodes.notes: DeepSeek V3 research worker: deep trade analysis and competitive positioning.

nodes.name: Claude Research Worker
nodes.notes: Claude 3.7 Sonnet research worker: high-fidelity industry nuance and intent mapping.

nodes.name: OpenRouter Research Worker
nodes.notes: OpenRouter multi-model worker fallback aggregator.

nodes.name: Research Fallback Floor
nodes.notes: Deterministic search query fallback when external AI workers are unavailable.

nodes.name: Research Merge & Synthesis
nodes.notes: Merges research notes from all responding providers into unified 0-research.json.

nodes.name: Bright Data & Maps Evidence
nodes.notes: Sourcing & Evidence: Extracts verified business listing, real reviews, photos, hours, and attributes.

nodes.name: Business Strategy Analyst
nodes.notes: businessAnalystAgent produces 4-strategy.json with cross-provider failover.

nodes.name: Content Authoring Worker
nodes.notes: writerAgent authors 5-content.json using routed content pool with automatic fallback to profile baseline.

nodes.name: Creative Direction
nodes.notes: designDirectorAgent generates master design directive (5a-directive.json).

nodes.name: Design Divergence Fork
nodes.notes: Forks directive into K=3 distinct candidates across structural archetype, visual density, and typography.

nodes.name: Design Candidate A (Structural Archetype)
nodes.notes: Candidate A: Structural layout perturbation (e.g. asymmetrical grid, split-screen hero showcase).

nodes.name: Design Candidate B (Visual Density & Rhythm)
nodes.notes: Candidate B: Spatial density & rhythm perturbation (e.g. compact high-contrast editorial).

nodes.name: Design Candidate C (Typographic & Motion)
nodes.notes: Candidate C: Typography, color temperature & motion perturbation.

nodes.name: Design Jury
nodes.notes: Evaluates Candidates A, B, C via deterministic quality scoring and conditional vision judge. Selects winner.

nodes.name: Asset Requirements Engine
nodes.notes: Extracts image, video hero, and 3D spatial asset requirements for the winner design.

nodes.name: Asset Workers Dispatcher
nodes.notes: Fans out to media generation workers with failover to curated/local assets.

nodes.name: Image Asset Worker
nodes.notes: Image Worker: Generates/optimizes imagery or routes to curated photography and SVG.

nodes.name: Video Hero Worker
nodes.notes: Video Worker (Veo/Sora/Kling/Higgsfield): Generates video hero or activates CSS motion fallback.

nodes.name: 3D Spatial Worker
nodes.notes: 3D Worker (Tripo/Meshy): Generates 3D models or activates WebGL/CSS3D spatial fallback.

nodes.name: Asset Aggregator & Manifest
nodes.notes: Combines generated and fallback assets into verified asset manifest.

nodes.name: Build & Assemble Site
nodes.notes: Compiles winner design, content, and assets into standalone production HTML/CSS bundle.

nodes.name: Browser Capture
nodes.notes: Playwright captures desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px) full-page screenshots.

nodes.name: UX & Technical Layout QA
nodes.notes: Measures rendered DOM for overlap, horizontal overflow, blank bands, and collapsed containers.

nodes.name: Visual Critic QA
nodes.notes: Vision model critique evaluating 13 visual and brand alignment axes.

nodes.name: Distinctness & Quality Gate
nodes.notes: Lexicographic quality gate: combines layout audit, visual critique, and peer-distinctness. Verdict PASS/FAIL.

nodes.name: Hermes Decision Engine
nodes.notes: Hermes Control Plane: Evaluates gate verdict, iteration count & budget. Emits deliver / reconcept / escalate.

nodes.name: Repair Needed?
nodes.notes: true -> Repair & Rebuild; false -> Delivered check.

nodes.name: Repair & Rebuild Engine
nodes.notes: Rebuilds design specifically targeting measured layout defects and gate diagnosis. Loops back into Browser Capture.

nodes.name: Delivered?
nodes.notes: true -> Observability & QA Report; false -> Escalate to Human.

nodes.name: Observability & QA Report
nodes.notes: Writes qa/report.json: business, iterations, gate scores, provider observability ledger, worker failovers, site path.

assignments.name: reason
assignments.value: ={{ "The gate did not pass within " + $("Job Intake").first().json.maxIter + " iteration(s). Screenshots, critique and gate reasons are in output/" + $("Job Intake").first().json.runId + "/." }}

nodes.name: Escalate to Human
nodes.notes: Explicit escalation path when gate fails after max iterations, recording exact failure reasons.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Terminal responder: returns final status, metrics, and site bundle to the caller.
